question: What claim is made about even a wise person who is burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence?
premises: Reference is made to the tip of nectar.
Reference is made to the tip of essence.
The particle api marks inclusion of even a wise person.
inference: Even a wise person, burning at the tip of nectar with the tip of essence, is included in the stated condition.
uncertainties: Result of that burning not stated in this verse
plain_english: At the tip of nectar, with the tip of essence, even a wise person, while burning, also.
